name: Content Import
description: Builds a complete product page for an agent skill or a pack of skills and imports it into a CMS: every form field written in French and English, a square cover, a poster and outcome images plus a presentation video rendered with Remotion, then the record created or updated through the CMS's API — or exported as files for any other CMS. CMS-agnostic: each CMS is a JSON profile (SkillzForest, generic export and a Strapi example included).
